Name: Christmas and Easter
Author: BackTac
Description:
A Simple mod that replaces the Winter Festival with Christmas and the Egg Festival with Easter.

This is my very first mod or rather content pack I've ever made so i would be very thankful for every tip or improvement suggestion :).

This only changes the Text files for both of the Events so they get called by their proper names.

Installation:
After you've installed SMAPI and Content patcher just drop the folder into the Mods folder in your stardew valley folder.



Only working for English and German.
Only some simple text changes.
